The '''assassination''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Karastace Gonn]] happened in [[3642 BBY]], when [[Darth Baras]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was able to locate Gonn and sent his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] to eliminate him.<ref name="Table" />
